title: तनहुँ जिल्लाका प्राथमिक तहमा अध्यनरत मगर बाल बालिकाहरुको शैक्षिक सहभागिता (Educational Participation of Magar Children Studying at Primary Level in Tanahun District)
authors: अर्याल Aryal, राधिका Radhika प्रियवदा Priyawada
nepali: प्राथमिक तहमा अध्यनरत मगर बाल बालिकाहरुको शैक्षिक सहभागिता सम्बन्धी लेख तनहुँ जिल्लाका प्राथमिक विद्यालयहरुमा आधारित एक अध्ययन हो । यस अध्ययनका प्रमुख उद्देश्यहरुमा मगर बाल बालिकाहरुको विद्यालय शिक्षामा सहभागिता पहिचान गर्ने तथा पहुँच विश्लेषण गर्ने, शिक्षामा मगर बाल बालिकाहरुका शैक्षिक समस्याहरुका बाधक तत्त्वहरु पहिचान गरी समस्या समाधानका उपायहरु पत्ता लगाउनु रहेका छन् । अध्ययनलाई व्यवस्थित तथा क्रमबद्ध बनाउन विभिन्न सिद्धान्त र अध्ययनहरुसँग तुलनात्मक रूपमा हेर्ने, विश्लेषण गर्ने र निष्कर्ष निकाल्नका लागि सम्बन्धित साहित्यहरुको समीक्षा गरियो । पाउलो फ्रेरेको Pedagogy of Oppressed लाई अध्ययनको प्रमुख सिद्धान्तको रूपमा लिइयो ।अध्ययन विधि अन्तर्गत अनुसन्धान ढाँचा निर्माण गरी जनसंख्या र नमुना छनोट गरिएको थियो । तनहुँ जिल्लाका दुई वटा मगर भाषी विद्यार्थीहरु अध्यनरत विद्यालयहरुलाई अध्ययनको रूपमा छनोट गरियो । अनुसन्धानका विविध साधनहरुको प्रयोग गरी प्राप्त तथ्य तथ्याङ्कलाई तुलनात्मक रूपमा विश्लेषण गरियो । समस्याहरुको समाधानार्थ अध्ययनले केही सुझावहरु औँल्याएको छ । जसमा सुविधा विहीन मगर बाल बालिकाहरुलाई विशेष सहुलियत उपलब्ध गराउनु पर्ने, मगर बाल बालिकाहरुलाई विभेद रहित शिक्षण गर्नु पर्ने र समाहित अवधारणा अनुसारको वातावरण विद्यालयले तयार गर्नु पर्ने देखिन्छ । विद्यालय विकास तथा व्यवस्थापनमा मगर समुदायको संलग्नतामा बढाउनु पर्ने जसबाटगर समुदायमा विद्यालयको स्वामित्वको भावना वृद्धि हुने देखियो । आदिवासी जनजाति र भाषिक अल्पसङ्ख्यक बाल बालिकाहरुको शिक्षामा पहुँच बढाउनु, मातृभाषामा शिक्षाको व्यवस्था गर्नु, बालमैत्री बाताबरणमा शिक्षण गर्नु जस्ता कुराहरुलाई यस अध्यनमा औँल्याइएको छ ।
american_english: The article concerning the educational participation of Magar children studying at the primary level is a study based on primary schools in Tanahun district. The main objectives of this study include identifying the participation and analyzing the access of Magar children in school education, and identifying the hindering factors of Magar children's educational problems in education and discovering measures for problem-solving. To make the study systematic and orderly, a review of related literature was conducted to examine comparatively with various theories and studies, analyze, and draw conclusions. Paulo Freire's Pedagogy of Oppressed was taken as the main theory of the study. Under the study methodology, a research design was developed, and the population and sample were selected. Two schools in Tanahun district where Magar-speaking students were studying were selected for the study. Using diverse research tools, the obtained facts and data were comparatively analyzed. Toward solving the problems, the study has pointed out several recommendations. Among these, it appears that special concessions must be provided to underprivileged Magar children, non-discriminatory teaching must be given to Magar children, and the school must prepare an environment according to an inclusive concept. The involvement of the Magar community in school development and management must be increased, whereby it was seen that the sense of school ownership in the Magar community would increase. Matters such as increasing the access of indigenous nationalities and linguistic minority children to education, providing education in the mother tongue, and teaching in a child-friendly environment are pointed out in this study.

informal_english: This article about the educational participation of Magar children studying at the primary level is a study based on primary schools in Tanahun district. The main goals of this study include identifying the participation and analyzing the access of Magar children in school education, and pinpointing the roadblock factors behind Magar kids' educational problems in education and finding ways to solve them. To keep the study organized and systematic, a review of related literature was conducted to examine comparatively with various theories and studies, analyze, and draw conclusions. Paulo Freire's Pedagogy of Oppressed was taken as the main theory of the study. Under the study methodology, a research framework was put together, and the population and sample were selected. Two schools in Tanahun district where Magar-speaking students were studying were picked for the study. Using various research tools, the obtained facts and data were comparatively analyzed. To help solve the problems, the study has pointed out several recommendations. Among these, it looks like special concessions must be provided to underprivileged Magar kids, non-discriminatory teaching must be given to Magar kids, and the school has to set up an environment according to an inclusive concept. Magar community involvement in school development and management must be boosted, whereby it was seen that a sense of school ownership in the Magar community would increase. Things like expanding educational access for indigenous nationalities and linguistic minority kids, providing schooling in their mother tongue, and teaching in a child-friendly environment are all pointed out in this study.
